name: HR Balance Management shows an empty state before leave types are configured

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'hr@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Open the 'Balance Management' page via the sidebar link (URL /hr/balances).
Verify the empty state is shown: the page contains the text 'No employee balances to display'.
